name: LowGuard-v2 minimal constraint repair after frozen Medium core
purpose: Preserve the selected persistent High/Medium core exactly while repairing only Low enough to satisfy the original no-significant-decline constraint.

relation_to_v1.v1_status: permanently rejected under its precommitted zero-negative/zero-ECDF internal gate
relation_to_v1.v2_reason: The original task requires no statistically significant Low decline, not per-snapshot bitwise dominance. Development also showed that the v1 safety penalty underfit the Low-only rerouter.

development_disclosure: The candidate was not fixed before snapshots 300-349. That window compared four training settings, seven saved epochs, and four fixed scales and is development selection evidence only.
postselection_robustness_disclosure: With hyperparameters then fixed, rolling past-only fits evaluated snapshots 150-349 out of fit. Aggregate Low mean improved versus both core and native Hattrick, while extreme P1/P10 were not uniformly better; this is development diagnosis, not independent confirmation.

validation_evidence_scope.role: one-shot Low-head/composite constraint check; not an independent confirmation of the frozen core's Medium result

benchmark_reuse_disclosure.future_400_499_role: adaptive confirmation of this exact frozen composite, not a globally untouched research holdout

fixed_candidate.core_selection: frozen before LowGuard-v2 development; High/Medium Medium-Pareto maximin selector

information_boundary.policy_inference_inputs: ESM predictions, topology, capacities, and frozen model parameters only
information_boundary.actual_tm_use: offline sequential-admission scoring and offline guard training labels only
information_boundary.pre_receipt_integrity_reads: Before the access receipt, the validator may hash immutable pre-existing source, checkpoint, manifest, and validation-artifact bytes solely to verify the frozen chain. It may not parse validation rows, construct snapshots 350-399, run policy inference, or compute candidate metrics before the receipt.
information_boundary.strict_counterfactual: literal-zero versus permuted actual TM must give bitwise-identical core policies, edge features, edge tolls, and final Low policy on CPU

primary_objective.comparison: native Hattrick under the same strict-ESM evaluator

low_constraint.native_no_significant_decline: paired bootstrap two-sided 95% upper bound must be nonnegative

one_shot_rule: The validator contains no optimizer or candidate loop. A separate authorization record anchors the final precommit, validator, protocol, core, and Low-head hashes. The validator atomically records an access receipt before constructing 350-399 and refuses any pre-existing output directory. Failure permanently rejects this v2 candidate; no threshold, scale, head, or checkpoint may be changed and reevaluated on 350-399.
test_rule: For this exact persistent-core plus LowGuard-v2 composite, snapshots 400-499 remain forbidden unless every joint-validation gate passes and a frozen composite manifest explicitly sets test_open_authorization=true.
